text_to_speech: this video shows you how to remove and charge the battery of your ring video doorbell 3 or 3 plus when your battery is running low will send you alerts by email and in the ring out so let's get charging switch the included screwdriver bit to the star-shaped end then use it to remove the security screw on the bottom of your video doorbell remove the faceplate by pulling the bottom edge towards you press this tab to unlock the battery then slide it out plug the charging cable into the battery while charging both lights will be lit when only one light is lit it's fully charged slide the battery back into its compartment you'll hear a click when the battery is secure pop the faceplate back on by slotting it in at the top and clicking it into place finally insert and tighten the security screw to lock it in need a little more help head to ring.com / help you

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: This video shows you how to remove and charge the battery of your ring video doorbell 3 or 3 plus.
When your battery is running low, we'll send you alerts by email and in the ring app.
Switch the included screwdriver bit to the star-shaped end.
Then use it to remove the security screw on the bottom of your video doorbell.
Remove the faceplate by pulling the bottom edge towards you.
Press this tab to unlock the battery, then slide it out.
Plug the charging cable into the battery.
While charging, both lights will be lit.
When only one light is lit, it's fully charged.
Slide the battery back into its compartment.
You'll hear a click when the battery is secure.
Pop the faceplate back on by slotting it in at the top and clicking it into place.
Finally, insert and tighten the security screw to lock it in.
Need a little more help? Head to ring.com slash help.
